strings: Creyda Yoga is a web development case study by Isaure Lohest, covering UX/UI decisions, implementation details, and final delivery.

A full redesign for Creyda, an integral yoga centre in Ixelles, Brussels, offering Hatha Yoga, prânayâma and meditation in small groups, wellbeing sessions and the R.E.S. method — Rhythm, Balance, Synchronicity — created by Patrick Noblet.

The site is built with Nuxt and Vue as a fast, statically generated front end. Accessibility was part of the brief: keyboard-friendly navigation, visible focus states, generous touch targets and real text rather than images of text.
Local SEO is built into the structure — descriptive headings, per-page titles and descriptions, and structured data so the centre surfaces on searches for yoga in Ixelles and Brussels.

Editorial typography, generous white space and a deep green give the centre a calm, grounded presence, while clear routes to classes, pricing and contact keep the experience practical for beginners and regular practitioners alike.

The green of a garden after rain, steady and alive. A pale mint breath of light across the mat, the soft grey of stone underfoot, and a single ink line for words — a palette that slows the eye down, the way a practice slows the breath.
